description: Find persisted posts whose embeddings are nearest to a free-text query — pgvector cosine over the local post library, no LinkedIn pull, free. Use when you have a *block of text* (a draft, a paragraph, a competitor's post) and want similar posts you've already collected. For keyword search prefer `search_posts`; for fresh LinkedIn keyword pulls use `linkedin_post_search`. Pass `profile_id` to scope to a tracked profile, `collection_id` to scope to a collection, or neither to search the entire library.

collection_id.description: Optional post_collections.id (scopes search to this collection's members)

profile_id.description: Optional tracked profile ID from list_profiles (scopes search to this profile's posts)

text.description: Text to find similar posts for

name: find_similar_posts
title: Find Similar Posts
